title: Bluetooth & devices
blurb: Pairing, headsets, AirPods, USB devices not recognised.

remedies.title: Bluetooth speaker or headphones paired but no sound
remedies.why: The sound still goes to another device, or the speaker connected only for calls.

steps.text: Choose the speaker as the output.
Choose the speaker as the output.
Turn the speaker's volume up; disconnect it from your phone.
Remove and pair again if it still stays silent.

remedies.title: Game controller doesn't connect
remedies.why: Controllers need pairing mode (or a cable) and some games need their own controller settings.

steps.text: Xbox controller: hold the pair button on top until the logo flashes, then Add device › Bluetooth.
PlayStation controller: hold PS + Share/Create until the light flashes, then pair.
A USB cable always works as a test.
Steam: Settings › Controller enables support for each kind.

remedies.title: Devices disconnect when plugged into a USB hub
remedies.why: Unpowered hubs can't supply drives and webcams, and USB power saving can switch ports off.

steps.text: Use a hub with its own power supply for drives and webcams.
Turn off USB selective suspend: Power options › Change plan settings › Advanced › USB settings.
Plug power-hungry devices straight into the computer.

remedies.title: Pen or drawing tablet doesn't work properly
remedies.why: The pen battery, pairing, or the tablet's driver.

steps.text: Charge or replace the pen battery; Surface pens pair in Bluetooth settings.
Install the tablet maker's driver and restart.
Allow the driver in Privacy & Security › Accessibility (and Input Monitoring).
